I changed the default in the script, but I couldn't apply it to the live task. The live task still fires at 02:00.

**What changed:** in `scripts/register-tasks.ps1`, `-BackupTime` now defaults to `03:30` instead of `02:00`, and the help text matches. I haven't committed it. I also didn't run the registration from WSL.

**Why the live task isn't updated:** the task runs with `RunLevel Highest`. PowerShell launched from WSL has a filtered, non-elevated token and can't prompt for UAC, so re-registering it would be denied. Changing the principal to get around that would be worse. A SYSTEM task can't see your WSL distros, so it would register fine and back up nothing.

**Run this from an elevated Windows prompt** (PowerShell, then *Run as administrator*):

```powershell
cd D:\repos\<owner>\wsl-automation
.\scripts\register-tasks.ps1
```

The default is now 03:30, so no parameter is needed. Fill in your actual `<owner>` in the path; I couldn't see it from here.

**Rollback:** the old task definition is saved in `wsl-backup.before.xml` in the repo root. It's untracked, so don't commit it. To restore it, run `Register-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\WslAutomation\' -TaskName 'WSL-Backup' -Xml (Get-Content -Raw .\wsl-backup.before.xml)`.

Tell me once it has run, and I'll read the task's trigger back to confirm it shows 03:30.
